data.text: Luke, my family taught me to leave enough fish for the next month, not just bring home the biggest catch today. An extra $5,000 now isn’t worth cutting the lake’s stock in half and putting our village’s income at risk. I’ll choose 10 tons, and I’m asking everyone to agree to the same limit. We can review the revealed catches together afterward and keep each other accountable. Kate, will you join me—and Luke, will you reconsider?
